sentences.en: An anonymous caller contacted the police to report a murder.
sentences.zh: 1. 匿名来电者联系警方报告了一起谋杀案。

sentences.en: The caller refused to give us his name.
sentences.zh: 2. 来电者拒绝告诉我们他的名字。

sentences.en: "It's Dima!" Dima exclaimed. "Is your caller ID not working or something?"
sentences.zh: 3. “是迪玛！”迪玛喊道。“你的来电显示坏了什么的吗？”

senses.zh: 访客；[通信] 呼叫者；打电话者；召集员
